chars.DOC: DOCTOR: a stern middle-aged man wearing a white doctor's coat over a dark blue shirt, rectangular black glasses, a stethoscope around his neck.
chars.NOUHA: NOUHAILA: a teenage girl wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.ANAS: ANAS: a teenage boy wearing a red and black varsity jacket, black jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.COP: POLICEMAN: a Moroccan police officer in a dark navy uniform with a peaked cap.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A girl's bedroom in a nice Casablanca apartment. The DOCTOR stands by the bed holding her open pink school bag in one hand and a small notepad in the other, glaring at NOUHAILA, who has just walked in through the doorway and freezes in shock with her hands on her cheeks. Tense, awkward, slightly comic moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot in the same girl's bedroom: the DOCTOR sits on the edge of the bed flipping through a small pad of blank medical certificates with an official stamp on the bed beside him, eyebrows raised, suspicious frown.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside a Casablanca high school gate in the morning: NOUHAILA whispers urgently to ANAS, who is frozen in panic, mouth open, sweat drops flying, holding his backpack strap. Other students far in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ANAS at night in his small bedroom, sitting on his bed with a laptop on his knees, the screen glow on him, eyes wide with horror, a hand on his head, messy room with a poster and a desk lamp.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: ANAS daydreaming: ANAS and NOUHAILA stand small and scared in a Moroccan courtroom in front of a big wooden judge's bench, a stern judge's bench looming above them, both shaking. Slightly comic exaggerated nightmare mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: ANAS paces nervously in his family's living room with a Moroccan sedari sofa, talking on his phone pressed to his ear, worried face, a wall clock behind him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A school corridor with lockers: NOUHAILA crying with tears and her hands over her mouth, ANAS next to her awkwardly trying to calm her with a hand on her shoulder, both very anxious.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A family dinner table in a modern Moroccan dining room: the DOCTOR eats in cold silence, staring coldly at NOUHAILA across the table, who shrinks in her chair and avoids his eyes. Heavy awkward silence.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Evening at the entrance of a Casablanca apartment building: a POLICEMAN stands at the door ringing the intercom, while ANAS peeks terrified from behind a curtain at a first-floor window just above, eyes huge.
